title: ulmus campestris var. suberosa
intro: Ulmus campestris var. suberosa, commonly known as Cork Elm, is a variety of the European Elm tree species. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ulmus campestris var. suberosa include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and tannins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
